answer: Require every new agent to post a decaying escrow bond: a deposit locked at entry and released only gradually as the agent completes verified useful work over successive epochs. A lone operator spinning up a plume of fake identities must fund each one separately, and a tide of cheap copies still cannot shortcut the waiting period — time, not money alone, buys standing. If an identity is caught cheating, its remaining bond burns like an ember snuffed out, so each fake costs real capital and yields nothing before detection.
